source_notes: 2026-11-13. German names (boss, cities), specialty types, teams, levels, moves: PokeWiki (pokewiki.de) article wikitext (Team/Zeile tables, infobox Name_en used to cross-check each English name); German move names mapped to PokeAPI identifiers with PokeAPI's move_names.csv. English location names from standard game names (not cross-checked online; Bulbapedia/Serebii blocked or 404 for automated fetch). Gym-leader teams are first battle only (rematches excluded); Gen5 B2W2 / SM / USUM teams use the Standard difficulty (first toggle) row; E4 teams are first round. Moves are empty arrays where the source lists none (e.g. Let's Go, several SwSh/SV leaders). Types of Champions (Alder, Kukui, Hau, Trace, Leon, Geeta) follow PokeWiki's infobox and are only nominal.
